messages:
emma_cs: FYI — APAC onboarding jobs hit intermittent 502s for a subset of tenants between 03:12–03:40 UTC. Need a short customer status and a plan for office hours + personalized RCAs.

raj_pm: Thanks — can we pair on a one-page status + recovery offer? We should be concise: timeline, impact, mitigation, next steps, and a recovery credit.

marta_eng: Root cause looks like a cascading reconnect bug in the assignment service; repro under high parallel import loads. Fix landed in staging, rollout to prod scheduled.

julian_support: Can we get the exact list of affected onboarding tenants and the CSV? CS needs to start outreach ASAP.

leo_csm: I'll segment by high-touch vs self-serve. High-touch get a personalized email + invite to office hours. Self-serve get the status note + feedback form.

sophie_ops: Office hours — propose: APAC-friendly time window 2024-07-19 04:00 UTC (12:00 JST / 11:00 SGT). 1-hour slot, capacity for 8 tenants.

emma_cs: Draft customer status (very short):
```
Hi <Customer>,

We observed intermittent onboarding failures for some tenants on July 19 between 03:12–03:40 UTC. Impact: certain file imports and embeddings ingestion failed with 502s and were retried by our system; some imports require manual re-run.

What we did: identified the issue, deployed a fix, and validated retries for most jobs.

Next steps: we are scheduling APAC office hours to assist with manual re-runs and provide a personalized RCA. We are also offering a recovery credit to affected accounts.

If you were impacted, please join: [APAC office hours link] or reply and we will reach out to schedule a time.

Sincerely,
Redwood Customer Success
```

raj_pm: Good. Ana (legal) needs to approve the credit wording. Ana, can you sign off or propose changes?

ana_legal: Looping in — quick note: avoid admitting systemic SLA breach language; offer credit as a gesture of goodwill and list steps taken. I can approve the current text with minor edits.

marta_eng: Deployment plan: canary at +5m, then region roll at +20m. Post-deploy smoke tests run. Will post rollout ticks here.

deploy_bot: canary deploy started for assignment-service:build-20240719-11 

marta_eng: Canary OK at 03:58 UTC. Rolling to APAC nodes now.

julian_support: CSV of affected tenants attached (internal link): https://redwood.internal/attachments/impacted_onboards_1784203344.csv — includes contact owner and account tier.

leo_csm: I'll draft personalized email for high-touch tenants using the template. For renewals at risk flagged in CRM, we should add a dedicated outreach and offer an extra session.

emma_cs: Proposed recovery offer copy: "We’re offering a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the affected onboarding monthly invoiced amount, plus a 60-minute enablement session for affected accounts." Thoughts?

ana_legal: 10% is fine. Recommend "one-time credit" language and require opt-in for the enablement session scheduling.

raj_pm: Metrics ask: can SRE/Telemetry give estimated % of jobs auto-recovered vs manual re-run needed? We want to include an estimate in comms.

marta_eng: Early numbers: ~78% auto-recovered; ~22% need manual re-run. I'll confirm by EOD and update the status letter with exact figures.

leo_csm: We'll include an ask for feedback: short form link to capture whether manuals were needed and satisfaction with assistance. Draft form: https://forms.redwood/rca-feedback (mock).

emma_cs: Great. Action items:
- leo_csm: send personalized outbound to high-touch list (by 04:30 UTC)
- julian_support: create tickets for tenants needing manual re-runs and assign to oncall (by 04:00 UTC)
- marta_eng: confirm percent recovery and paste final technical summary (by 05:00 UTC)
- ana_legal: quick signoff on final comms (by 04:15 UTC)
- sophie_ops: publish office hours calendar and link (by 04:00 UTC)

sophie_ops: Office hours link published: https://meet.redwood/apac-office-hours-20240719 (capacity 8).

leo_csm: Sending first batch now for top 12 high-touch tenants. Will bcc and track opens.

julian_support: Tickets created and triage started. Tagging eng-oncall for manual re-runs.

marta_eng: Final numbers: 79% auto-recovered, 21% manual. Technical summary for comms: assignment-service timed out during reconnection flooding; root cause fix was connection backoff + queue drain patch.

emma_cs: Ana, please confirm legal text and we'll push the final template.

ana_legal: Approved with one minor edit: replace "we caused" with "you experienced". Otherwise good.

emma_cs: Final customer note updated and scheduled to go out at 04:45 UTC. Office hours invite included. Recovery credit process documented in the ticket template.

raj_pm: Also flag any renewal accounts where this incident could be an activation/renewal risk. Sales should be notified.

leo_csm: Noted. I flagged 4 renewal accounts in CRM and pinged their AEs.

emma_cs: Quick ask — after office hours, collect a short RCAsatisfaction score and one-line feedback for product learnings. We'll include a 2-question follow-up (satisfaction + what we could improve).

leo_csm: Will include link in follow-up email.

marta_eng: Postmortem ETA: full RCA doc by 2024-07-22 COB. I'll post link here when ready.

emma_cs: Thanks team. Closing thread after office hours; will reopen if any escalation. :white_check_mark:

sophie_ops: NOTE: Office hours full (8/8). Creating overflow 1:1 slots for the remaining requests.

leo_csm: Received a request for a localized Mandarin session — scheduling separately with our solutions engineer.

emma_cs: Perfect. Thanks everyone.
